text:
maria: Heads up — HelixRetail pilot activity dropped ~45% WoW after last week's onboarding session. main admin changed to a new procurement lead so usage looks paused.
jon: Saw the spike down in the dashboard. Is this a client-side integration issue or a product/limits thing?
sara: Ran a quick query against our usage store:
```
SELECT count(*) as tokens_used
FROM production_usage
WHERE account_id = 'helix_retail'
  AND ts >= now() - interval '7 days';
```
Numbers: 3200 tokens -> 1750 tokens week-over-week. no 5xx spikes in logs.
maria: Customer note from yesterday: "we're doing a side-by-side with ModelOps for cost, will circle back" :worried:
jon: that wording = competitive eval. we should move fast. who can own an outreach to the new procurement lead?
maria: i'm on it for outreach. scheduled an intro with the new lead + our champion for Tue 3/15 10am PT. invite sent. :calendar:
derek: Re: retention play — can we extend pilot credits by 30% and open a short Dedicated trial window? Finance said AE can approve a small bridge credit for rescue use cases.
jon: AE ok to approve bridge credits. need an ops ticket so RevOps can track consumption. also if procurement asks for pricing comps, prepare a formal delta table.
sara: i'll prep a short technical doc showing latency/cost tradeoffs and a quick quantization recommendation for their workload. will join the call. linking internal playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/competitive-rescue (internal)
maria: Plan for the call: 1) quick status check with new procurement lead, 2) demo focused on tail latency and cost per request, 3) offer 2-week credit extension + tech audit, 4) follow-up with a written cost/latency comparison vs ModelOps. anyone want to own meeting notes and follow-ups?
jon: i'll take notes + procurement checklist follow-up. will push pricing delta doc and a clear renewal cadence proposal.
ops-bot: ticket created: #7891 — helix_retail_pilot_credit_extension (created by derek)
maria: Thanks all. action items: @jon follow-up doc, @sara tech audit + join call, @derek open ticket and confirm credit amount, i'll run demo and own outreach. We'll aim to resolve in 10 business days.
jon: :thumbsup:
